checkpoints: every 10 epochs and best weighted validation loss, up to 80 epochs
selection: zero local negative triggers at all 20ms offsets, at least 3/4 local STOP detections at every 200ms phase, >=70% public clean STOP recall, <=1% other-word FP separately clean/noisy, zero validation synthetic background activations; maximize worst-phase local recall then mean local recall then mean public recall then lower threshold
old_device_recordings: excluded; random initial weights, wider DS-CNN
frontend: subtract temporal mean independently for each mel band within every 49-frame window
public_replay: up to 6000 unique examples per class; weight each public class to total 2000
